name: WhatsApp
description: Connect a WhatsApp Business number and exchange messages, media and voice notes through Hay's AI

ui.title: Connect WhatsApp
ui.intro: Connect a WhatsApp Business number so Hay's AI can answer your customers on WhatsApp — text, media and voice notes.

statusError.title: Couldn't load the WhatsApp status

embedded.intro: Connect your WhatsApp Business number in a Meta popup — no tokens to copy or paste.
embedded.notConfigured: Embedded Signup isn't configured on this Hay server (META_APP_ID and META_WHATSAPP_ES_CONFIG_ID are not set). Use the Manual token tab instead.
embedded.notActive: Embedded Signup isn't the active connection method. Choose "Embedded Signup" under Connection method above and save before connecting.
embedded.connectedHint: Your number is connected through Embedded Signup. To connect a different number, disconnect above and connect again.
embedded.httpsHint: Meta's popup only works over https. For local testing, expose the dashboard through a tunnel (ngrok or cloudflared) and add that origin to your Meta app's allowed domains.

explainer.title: Good to know
explainer.ownership: Your number stays yours — Hay connects to it through Meta, and you can disconnect at any time.
explainer.coexistence: Already using the WhatsApp Business app on your phone? The popup offers to keep it (coexistence), so you can still reply from the app.
explainer.billing: Meta bills WhatsApp messages to your business directly — Hay adds no fee. Each number gets 1,000 free service messages per month.

manual.intro: For self-hosted Hay, or to connect a number from your own Meta app. You'll copy a few values from Meta into the form above.
manual.active: Manual token is the active connection method.
manual.notActive: Manual token isn't the active method yet — choose it under Connection method above and save.

app.title: Create a Meta app
app.body: In Meta for Developers, create a Business type app and add the WhatsApp product. Connecting your own number this way makes you a Direct Integrator — no App Review needed.

token.title: Generate a permanent token
token.body: In Business Settings → Users → System users, create a system user, give it access to your app and WhatsApp account, and generate a token that never expires with the whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions.

ids.title: Copy your IDs
ids.body: In your app, open WhatsApp → API Setup and copy the Phone number ID and the WhatsApp Business Account ID.

form.title: Fill in the form above
form.body: Choose Manual token under Connection method, then paste the token, both IDs, your app secret (App settings → Basic) and a verify token of your choice. Save.

webhook.title: Point Meta's webhook at Hay
webhook.body: In your Meta app, open WhatsApp → Configuration and set this callback URL, with the same verify token you saved in Hay. Then subscribe to the messages webhook field.

register.title: Register the number
register.body: If the number isn't registered for the Cloud API yet, register it in WhatsApp → API Setup.

health.coexistenceValue: Also in use on the phone
health.sandbox: This is a sandbox (test) number — it can only message recipients added in your Meta app.

payment.title: Payment method
payment.missing: Meta bills you directly for WhatsApp messages. Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager — without one, replies stop after the free 1,000 service messages per number per month.
payment.open: Add payment method in WhatsApp Manager
payment.stillMissing: No payment method found yet. It can take a minute to show up after you add it.
